message:
Hi Niki, I'm sorry about that. Please give me a moment to review the files, and I'll resend them shortly.

Thank you for your patience, and I appreciate you bringing it to my attention.

Thank you for these. Would this fixed cost include the brand colours and fonts set out for us? The lettering on the truck (the light up words 'Global Dough Truck' is 'Clab but we don't necessarily want or need to use the same for the logo). We hope to hire you but we just thought we should double check about the colour and font guidelines that could be produced.
Yes, absolutely. The fixed cost includes the brand colors and font as well, so you'll have everything needed to maintain a consistent brand identity moving forward.
Please let me know if you have any specific timeline in mind for the completion of this project. I’m available to get started immediately.

Hi, thanks for clarifying. No immediate rush as we are both busy with our day to day work whilst trying to kickstart this start up but maybe within the next 2 weeks if that works for you? We need to complete the hire contract for you so please bear with us!

Yes, that's perfect.
Sure, looking forward to receiving the contract.
Thank you for the offer. I will get back to you with the initial concepts.

Hi, before you start on concepts we’ll send you some concepts we like but of course we’re also interested in your own ideas. So I wouldn’t start on concepts just yet till we’ve got back to you. Thanks, Niki

Of course, that sounds like a great approach. Please send over any concepts or references you like when you're ready, and I'll review them carefully before starting the creative process.

I'm looking forward to seeing your inspirations and then combining them with my own ideas to create something unique and memorable for your brand.
Hi Niki, looking forward to recieveing the inspiration concepts.
Hi, bear with us! It’s been one of those weeks! We’ve not forgotten.
Sure, looking forward to it.

Hi, Attached is a draft logo created by AI (obviously we were just tinkering about with chat gpt). However, we are looking for fresh original ideas (hence our proposal) but we do like those colours as they match the look and feel of the Global Dough truck. Our company name is 'Global Dough' so we don't want the word 'truck' in the logo. The 'truck' element is just one part of the business . In other words 'Global Dough' (the business for which we need a logo) will be operating a mobile catering truck, selling food online and possibly selling to other caterers/kitchens. So that's why the company name is just 'Global Dough' but the strapline remains the same. Happy to chat through anything before you accept the offer?
This is the truck but the business is more than just this, as explained above.
Got it. I'll create a few concepts that align closely with your vision while adding a creative touch to ensure the designs are both visually appealing and unique.
I usually prefer to accept the offer after sharing the initial drafts, as it gives clients an opportunity to review the direction first and feel completely comfortable moving forward.

That said, I'm flexible and happy to work with whatever makes you most comfortable. If you'd prefer, I can accept the offer after presenting the initial concepts, or if you'd like me to accept it right away, I have no problem with that as well.
Yes let's go with your approach - intial drafts first. Thank you
Thank you.

Hi Niki, please take a look at the initial drafts and let me know your thoughts. I'd love to hear your feedback.

Feel free to let me know if you'd like any revisions, refinements, iterations, or changes. I'm happy to work with you until we achieve a result that perfectly matches your vision.

Hi, thank you so much for these. Matt (my partner - who is the chef and the creator of the business!!) and I have had a look at them. I've attached our feedback onto a powerpoint. Hopefully it makes sense. Please let me know if you're unsure of what we mean. All best, Niki
Hey Niki, thanks for the feedback. I iwll review your comments, and I'll get back to you with the updated designs.
Hi Niki, please review and let me know your feedback.

Thanks for these. We like the graduated colour in the orange and the lines next to the strapline.

We like the 1st and 3rd one (the font in the 2nd one is too plain) but if people don’t know our name they may not realise the flame in the 3rd one is a ‘O’! But we do like it!

So maybe the flame needs to be encased in an ‘O’ or the flame needs to look more like the shape of an ‘O’ or superimposed onto an ‘O’?
Can you try all these suggestions?

Regarding logo 3, let’s see what it looks like with a slightly larger ‘dough’? Can you make the strapline stand out by either outlining every letter in thin black pencil line or brightening the tone of the oranges in the strapline lettering slightly? We like the font for global dough as it has character, especially the G. We were wondering if a little ‘character’ could be given to a couple of other letters but we thought let’s do revisions one stage at a time as the current font could be okay. Thank you - we are heading in the right direction.
Thank you for the feedback. I'll review it and get back to you if I have any questions.
Hi Niki, I have incorporated the feedback. Please review the updated designs and let me know your thoughts.
Thanks for these. Just been swamped with work so we’ll get back to you over the weekend.
Sure, take your time.

Hi, sorry for the delay.

Matt likes number 4 (the one where the strapline is the same colour as ‘global’ and both have graduated colours).

However, I was wondering whether you could give the ‘global dough’ font a little more character? As the food will be truly authentic, freshly cooked with flavours from around the world. So I like the interesting shape of the ‘G’ in both words. Could that be done to more of the letters without over-doing it? thanks, Niki

Hi Niki, Sure! I'll take a look, see what I can do, and get back to you with an updated draft.
Thank you.

I believe these two options are about the maximum amount of character we can add without affecting the logo's overall quality and readability. Going beyond this point would start to take away from its clean, refined look and make it less versatile across different applications.

I've focused on adding subtle personality to the letterforms while preserving the premium, authentic feel of the brand. I feel this gives the logo a unique touch without compromising its overall balance and professionalism.
Please review and let me know your thoughts.

Hi, thank you for these. Nearly there!
1\. On the second logo, can you please make the U and the H smaller so they are the same height as the rest of the letters in the word ‘ DOUGH’.
2\. please can you flip the the top of the right hand side of the H in DOUGH so it mirrors the top of the U in DOUGH.
3\. And finally can you add the same feature to the top of the D in DOUGH - like the top of the B in GLOBAL?
See the attached annotated screenshot.
Then, we’ll take another look and hopefully it’ll still look ‘clean’ but with the character.
Many thanks, Niki

Hi Niki,

Absolutely, I'll make those changes and get back to you with an updated design.
Please review.

Hi, oops I thought I’d got back to you!

We’d like to go agreed with that final version (above) - rev4-02. Thank you!

I’m assuming the logo would be with and without the black box (as a black box won’t work for everything)?

And we would get all colour variants you have shown?

However, I think the main logo would be the (graduated) orange ‘global’ with a black ‘dough’ and graduated orange strapline as shown in the top row of the final version.

So we just need logo guidelines and all file types to use across online, social media, on the truck itself and other hard copy materials eg pull up banners, or printed menus, uniform etc .

As the files will be large file sizes how do you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, Niki

Hi Niki, that sounds great! When you have a moment, could you please approve the first milestone and activate the second so I can continue with the remaining work?

Yes, I'll provide the logo both with and without the black box.

Regarding the color variants, did you mean all of the color versions we've explored throughout the design process, or were you referring to the standard full-color, black, and white versions?

I'll also deliver all of the necessary file formats, including fully editable source files, so you can use the logo across print, web, social media, signage, merchandise, and any other applications. I'll also include the font details and color codes used in the final design.

Regarding the logo guidelines, I just wanted to clarify that they weren't included in our original project scope. Logo guidelines are typically delivered as a separate project.

There are two options:

Basic Logo Usage Guidelines – $100
Includes logo variations, clear space, minimum size, color palette, typography, and basic do's and don'ts.

Complete Brand Guidelines – $150
Includes everything in the basic guide, plus a more comprehensive brand system covering typography hierarchy, imagery style, iconography, layout principles, brand applications, stationery and t-shirt mockups, and detailed usage rules.

If you'd like, I'd be happy to create either version for you to ensure your logo is used consistently and professionally across all future branding materials.

Hi, have you received the first $75? And has the second $75 been released? I’m not sure if I’ve done enough to release the second amount. I’ll double check.

Maybe I don’t mean guidelines. Earlier on in our messaging you said it included “Yes, absolutely. The fixed cost includes the brand colors and font as well, so you'll have everything needed to maintain a consistent brand identity moving forward.” I think that’s what I mean.

Regarding colour, just the three you stated above.

Thanks, Niki

The first milestone is released, and the second milestone needs to be activated/funded before it can be released.

Yes, if you mean the brand colors and fonts, I will deliver those in the final files without any additional cost as discussed.

Sure, I will include those color versions as well.
Should be released now?

It's activated now; you can release it once I submit the final files.
I will be submitting the final files within an hour.
I won’t be able to review everything until tomorrow evening but I’ve released the final payment in the meantime.

No problem at all, please take your time reviewing everything.

Once you're completely satisfied with the final deliverables, I'd really appreciate it if you could close the contract. I am expecting a 5-star rating and a few words of positive feedback. It would mean a lot to me and would really help my profile.

Thank you again, and if you need any final adjustments, I'll be happy to help.

Hi, I've only just had time to sit down and open the files on my laptop. I'm afraid I can't open the colour codes doc as it comes up with an error. I can open the jpgs just fine and the pdfs. I can't open the AI, EPS or the PSD. Regarding png only logo 4 opens properly - the rest don't open properly. Also, when we do the website and other materials what font did you use or did you create it? If it's the latter, what font should we use to complement the logo or even match it e.g. some headers? Thanks, Niki

Hi Niki,

Thanks for checking the files and letting me know.

The PSD file can only be opened in Adobe Photoshop, while the AI and EPS files require Adobe Illustrator (or another compatible vector editing program). If those applications aren't installed, the files won't open correctly.

Regarding the PNG files, I'll check the issue with the ones that aren't opening properly and send you corrected versions.

As for the font, the logo lettering is completely custom-made, so it isn't based on a specific font. However, I can recommend a very similar font that complements the logo well and can be used for your website, headings, and other branding materials to maintain a consistent look.

Please let me know if you'd like me to suggest a few font options.

Hi, thanks for clarifying. I can’t open the colour codes doc either. I’ll wait to head back from you regarding the PNG files. If you need me to send you sceeenshots of what I can see when I try to open them I can do so later. Yes, would be great if you can recommend fonts that would complement the logo. Thanks, Niki

Hi Niki,

Thanks for letting me know. No worries at all. I'll resend the colour codes document and check the PNG files. If I still can't identify the issue, I'll ask you to send screenshots later.

I'll also put together a few font recommendations that complement the logo and send them over shortly.

Thanks!
Thank you - also can you please put in writing that we own the copyright and then we can trademark the logo in due course and tick all those boxes!

You're very welcome! Yes, I can prepare a Copyright Transfer Certificate confirming that the copyright has been assigned to you, which you can keep for your records and use when applying for a trademark.

There is an additional charge of $50 for preparing the certificate. Let me know if you'd like me to go ahead, and I'll get it ready for you.
Please can you email a draft/template certificate so I can check the wording is sufficient?
Please send me your email address so I can share the draft certificate.
Please share the full name and address that you want to be used in the trademark certificate.

I've reviewed the PNG files, and the logos themselves are opening correctly. The issue is that the background color is blending with parts of the logo, making it appear as though it's not displaying properly.

If you zoom in, you'll be able to see the text and logo clearly. An easy way to check this is to drag and drop the PNG file into any web browser or paint app, where it should display correctly, and you'll be able to view it without any issues.

Once you check, please let me know.

Below are the suggestions for similar fonts

Fonts Name:

Intervogue Soft Alt Black

Haboro Soft Normal Extra Bold
Here are the Color codes.
Hey Niki, please share your email address so I can send you the certificate script.
Gosh sorry I forgot as there is a lot happening our end. Pls use matt@globaldough.co.uk
I understand that. I am sending you the email right now. Please review and let me know.
Yep will do when I can
Do you want me to share that there as well?
Just shared that here also.
Can you please also add and activate the milestone for the certificate?
Please check your email. Thank you.

Hi, here's the certificate.

Could you please close the contract? I'm expecting a 5-star rating and a positive review.

It was a pleasure working with you, and I hope we have the opportunity to work together again in the future. Thank you!

Could you please close the contract? I'm expecting a 5-star rating and a positive review.
